elements.label: Figure 1
elements.title: Total external debt, 2015–25
elements.description: Total external debt generally rose from 2015 to 2025, with a few intervening declines. The lowest plotted point is in 2015 and the highest is in 2025.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.

elements.description: The total external debt bar is divided into public and publicly guaranteed, private nonguaranteed, and short-term debt; private nonguaranteed is the largest component. A connecting band expands public and publicly guaranteed debt into multilateral, bilateral, and private creditors. Further bands expand multilateral debt into IMF-SDR allocations, World Bank-IBRD, and other multilateral, and bilateral debt into Japan, Germany, and other bilateral. IMF-SDR allocations dominate the multilateral breakdown, while Japan dominates the bilateral breakdown; other bilateral is the smallest printed component.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.

elements.label: Figure 3
elements.title: Debt ratios, 2015–25
legend: 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries (shaded band)
elements.description: Four small line charts show external debt and debt service relative to exports and GNI from 2015 to 2025. The displayed 2025 ratios range from 49% for external debt / exports to 2% for debt service / GNI. All four displayed changes are negative.
elements.notes: Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries. Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.

elements.label: Figure 4
elements.title: Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025
elements.description: Two boxes compare 2025 terms for official and private creditors, each showing maturity, grace period, and interest rate with small bars. Official creditors show 13 years, 4 years, and 5.3%, respectively; private creditors show 48 years, 48 years, and 7.2%. Private creditors have the higher displayed value for each term.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
